ranked_candidates.name: Finite-lag cross-physics edge pairing
ranked_candidates.physical_signature: At a detrended-elevation edge, a similarly oriented gravity edge occurs 1-8 pixels (100-800 m) away on either side; zero-lag is the control; scales are sigma 2 and 5 px.
ranked_candidates.missing_catalogue_rationale: A subdued surface break and subsurface density/basement contact may be offset by basin cover or structure; lithologic contacts and processing offsets are confounders.
ranked_candidates.difference_from_existing_code: H-X1 evaluates magnetic/gravity zero-lag concordance; H-E broad co-location; H-H potential-field endpoints and relays; K1 scale-persistent tilt-like phase. H53-A tests bounded nonzero surface-to-gravity lag.
ranked_candidates.expected_benefit: Moderate but uncertain; no numeric forecast.
ranked_candidates.implementation_cost: Medium; existing pinned layers, six frozen spatial blocks.
ranked_candidates.current_status: Stage 1 measured separately; Stage 2 not run because the canonical frozen-baseline reproduction gate failed. Not a candidate failure or promotion.

ranked_candidates.name: Multi-kilometre structural chord persistence
ranked_candidates.physical_signature: Integrate weak spatial support along 3-10 km straight chords to test coherent, partially buried fault traces.
ranked_candidates.missing_catalogue_rationale: Long fault segments may be partially obscured while separated fragments retain alignment; non-fault linear contacts are alternatives.
ranked_candidates.difference_from_existing_code: Existing STE integrates along a 9-pixel (0.9 km) line; H53-B tests a distinct 30-100 pixel scale and chord geometry.
ranked_candidates.current_status: Untested; requires a new preregistration and a valid baseline.

ranked_candidates.name: Independent LiDAR face-polarity contrast
ranked_candidates.physical_signature: Signed imbalance between opposing topographic-face responses around a candidate step, normalized by local relief.
ranked_candidates.missing_catalogue_rationale: A subtle one-sided displacement may remain where absolute scarp strength is low; drainage and lithologic benches are alternatives.
ranked_candidates.difference_from_existing_code: H-D measures directional coherence/persistence and P1 measured odd/even elevation profiles; H53-C uses an up/down face ratio/contrast, not either tested score.
ranked_candidates.outside_data: None; the DEM-derived layer provenance remains owner-mirrored, not organizer-authenticated.
ranked_candidates.current_status: Untested; requires a new preregistration and a valid baseline.

external_data_policy: No new external data is required for the ranked slate; inputs are already present in the hash-pinned owner mirror.
